title: Online store
subtitle: Storefront switch, online hours and website orders
selectBranch: Choose a specific branch in the header to manage its storefront.

switch.title: Online ordering
switch.description: Turn the website menu and checkout on or off instantly for this branch.
switch.label: Accept online orders
switch.on: The website can take new orders right now.
switch.off: The website shows the menu but checkout stays closed.

hours.title: Online opening hours
hours.description: Set the hours the website takes orders for each day. Turn it off to take online orders around the clock.
hours.limit: Limit online ordering to specific hours
hours.overnight: A closing time at or before the opening time runs past midnight (10:00 → 01:00 closes at 1 AM the next morning).
hours.error: Each open day needs an opening and a closing time, and they must differ.

recent.title: Recent online orders
recent.description: Newest website orders · orders list and kitchen update automatically
recent.emptyMessage: Orders placed on the website will appear here and on the kitchen board.

toast.savedMessage: The website reflects this change immediately.

error.title: Online store unavailable
error.message: Could not load the storefront settings.

note: Online orders are tagged in the orders list and the kitchen board. Card orders reach the kitchen only after the payment is captured.
